NL.name: Verplichte weg voor ruiters
NL.description: Verplichte weg voor ruiters. Andere weggebruikers mogen dit pad niet gebruiken.

EN.name: Mandatory path for horse riders
EN.description: This sign indicates a mandatory path for horse riders. Horse riders must use this path. Pedestrians and vehicles are not allowed on this path. This sign is often placed in large parks or rural areas with horse farms.
